title: 第16章 黑卡第17章 打脸
content_zh:
看着面前这个有着亲切笑容的女销售，白月刚才被那极品男销售搞坏的心情才稍微缓和了些。
便直入主题的问：“你们这里最好的商务车有哪些？”
销售小维以为白月二人只是前来看一些普通的车辆，没想到她上来就是问最好的车型，不由得一愣。
不过，很快她就恢复了自己的专业素养，露出了职业化的微笑，朝着白月道：
“二位请跟我来。”
小维把白月二人引导了二楼的一个贵宾包间。
“请问二位是谁要买车呢？”
小维看着在贵宾包间坐下的二人道。
“是我要帮我的叔叔买车，我的叔叔公司业务比较忙，抽不出空，所以我代他来买了，你不用为难，我能做得了主。”
白月直截了当的说。
小维微微一愣，只当她是哪家公司老板的千金，便吩咐后勤人员给他们上好茶水。
“请问小姐您贵姓呢？”
“我姓白。”
“好的，白小姐。”
待上好了茶水后，小维便拿着一叠杂志样的车型品牌宣传介绍册，摊开在桌上，让白月二人慢慢的观看研究。
待看好了便可以告诉她，到时再把他们带到展厅去真车上体验一下。
白月和云风二人边翻着册子，边听着小维为她们逐一的讲解着。
发现小维服务不仅细心周到，对各种车的配置性能都了如指掌，可以说业务能力非常的强，起码比刚才那个不三不四的男销售强多了。
但是经询问发现，她在这家店里不过是一个普通员工，每个月也就那六七百块钱的薪水，若是没有业绩提成，怕是要更低，根本都不够养家糊口的。
瞬间也起了爱才之心，想要将小维纳入自己预想的企业规划队伍中，不过这得看她的意愿，不能强求。

想着白月递给了小维一张给祝言弄好的名片，说道：“如果你以后在这里过的不好，欢迎随时打这个电话。”
小维接到白月递来的名片有些发愣，虽然自己并不需要跳槽什么的，但看着白月的一番好意，她也只好把名片收好，转而更加卖力的宣传道：
“白小姐，你看，这是我们店内最新的车型，奔驰S600，是奔驰S系列的顶级型号，装备有最新型的V12发动机，车还装载着很许多高科技的设备，像是电子稳定程式系统ESp等等...可以说很符合你描述的精英阶层的叔叔，这款车就是成功人士的必备首选。”
小维在一旁孜孜不倦的说着，边说边看着白月的神色。
白月看了看宣传册上的图，又联想了一下祝言和祝星洲那对爱穿黑衣的父子。
问道：“这个车型有黑色的吗？”
“有，有的！我们店里刚刚进货了一辆黑色的S600，整个店内就这么一辆了。”
见白月满意的点了点头，小维便欣喜的说：“要不我先带你们去看看车？”
“好，那就去看看吧。”
说着，小维便把白月二人带到了二楼的展厅内。
content_en:
Looking at the female saleswoman with a friendly smile in front of her, Bai Yue's mood that had just been ruined by the best male salesperson eased a little.
Then he went straight to the point and asked: "What are the best commercial vehicles here?"
Salesperson Xiao Wei thought that Bai Yue and the others just came to look at some ordinary vehicles, but she didn't expect that she came up to ask about the best car model, and she couldn't help but be stunned.
However, she soon regained her professionalism, showed a professional smile, and said to Bai Yue:
"You two, please come with me."
Xiao Wei guided Bai Yue and the others to a VIP private room on the second floor.
"Who among you wants to buy a car?"
Xiao Wei looked at the two people sitting in the VIP room and said.
"I want to help my uncle buy a car. My uncle's company is busy and he can't spare the time, so I'm buying it on his behalf. You don't have to be embarrassed. I can make the decision."
Bai Yue said straightforwardly.
Xiaowei was slightly startled, thinking that she was the daughter of the owner of some company, and ordered the logistics staff to serve them tea.
"Excuse me, Miss, what is your surname?"
"My surname is Bai."
"Okay, Miss Bai."
After the tea was served, Xiaowei took a stack of magazine-like car model and brand brochures and spread them out on the table, letting Bai Yue and the two of them slowly watch and study them.
You can tell her when you have a good look, and then take them to the showroom to experience the real car.
Bai Yue and Yunfeng were flipping through the booklet and listening to Xiaowei explain to them one by one.
I found that Xiaowei's service is not only attentive and thoughtful, but also knows the configuration and performance of various cars. It can be said that his business ability is very strong, at least much better than the mediocre salesman just now.
However, after questioning, it was found that she was just an ordinary employee in this store, and her monthly salary was only six to seven hundred yuan. Without performance commission, it would probably be even lower, which would not be enough to support her family.
Instantly, she also developed a love for talents and wanted to include Xiaowei in her envisioned corporate planning team, but this depended on her wishes and could not be forced.
Thinking of it, Bai Yue handed Xiaowei a business card for Zhu Yan and said, "If you have a bad time here in the future, you are welcome to make this call at any time."
Xiaowei was in a daze when she received the business card handed over by Bai Yue. Although she didn't need to change jobs or anything, seeing Bai Yue's kindness, she had no choice but to put the business card away and then promoted even more vigorously:
"Miss Bai, look, this is the latest model in our store. The Mercedes-Benz S600 is the top model of the Mercedes-Benz S series. It is equipped with the latest V12 engine. The car is also equipped with many high-tech equipment, such as the electronic stability program system ESP and so on... It can be said that it fits your description of the uncle of the elite class. This car is the must-have first choice for successful people."
Xiao Wei spoke tirelessly on the side, looking at Bai Yue's expression as he spoke.
Bai Yue looked at the picture in the brochure and thought about Zhu Yan and Zhu Xingzhou, a father and son who like to wear black.
Asked: "Is this model available in black?"
"Yes, yes! We have just purchased a black S600 in our store. It is the only one in the whole store."
Seeing Bai Yue nodding with satisfaction, Xiaowei said happily: "How about I take you to see the car first?"
"Okay, let's go and have a look."
With that said, Xiao Wei took Bai Yue and the two to the exhibition hall on the second floor.
